game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell. Each round, rogue crows strike the market bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the market bell from rogue crows in Postern Gate: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while energy > 0.
